goal: A project can push, open a pull request, and merge on GitHub, Gitea, or GitLab through the same WorkItem records used for local Git
scenarios: developer registers a GitHub, Gitea, or GitLab repository on a project
developer pushes a WorkItem branch to the hosted provider
developer opens a hosted pull request linked to the WorkItem
developer merges the hosted pull request
push, pull request, and merge still require human approval
local Git still works without GitHub
Code View shows the hosted pull-request URL
customer cannot register a hosted repository or push
constraints: core operation does not require GitHub
agent push, pull request, and merge still need C1 approval
the same WorkItem branch and pull-request records are used for every provider
